other.remelting: flipped and re-melted 5 times with electromagnetic stirring

evidence.quote: Alloy ingots with a nominal composition of (Fe40Mn40Co10Cr10)100−xCx ... were prepared by arc melting pieces of 99.9% Fe, 99.8% Mn, 99.9% Co, 99.8% Cr and 99% graphite under a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere in a water-cooled copper hearth.
each ingot was ﬂipped and re-melted 5 times with electromagnetic stirring and then drop casted into a plat with dimension of 60 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm.
some C3.3 as cast plats were hot forged at 1123 K to a total thickness reduction of about 70%
then solution treated for 30 min at 1373 K followed by water quenching
